title: Coulomb equilibrium in the external field of an attractive-repellent pair of charges
summary: The aim of this paper is to provide a complete analysis of the Coulomb equilibrium problem in the euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\geq2$, associated to the kernel $1/|x|^{d-2}$, with a non-convex external field created by an attractive-repellent pair of charges placed in $\mathbb{R}^{d+1} \setminus \mathbb{R}^d$. We consider the admissible setting, where the equilibrium measure is compactly supported, as well as the limiting weakly admissible setting, with a weaker external field at infinity, where the existence of the equilibrium measure still holds but possibly with an unbounded support.…
